issues.title: Trailing newline on every message/warn/fail on Bitbucket Cloud
issues.body:
Hi!

I've been trying to use endanger on our projects on Bitbucket, but it seems like there is an extra \n or new line at the end of every message, even if there wasn't any on the  as can be seen on the image below.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51753940/149219622-0066ad0b-75fd-434d-b305-3deb3ebf1792.png)

Is there a way to remove those trailing new lines?

source code:

```
...
      messages: {
            missingPrefix: "{where} não está marcado com um prefixo válido. Deve iniciar com 'bugfix/', 'feature/' ou 'hotfix/'.",
            prefixThanks: ":thumbsup: Obrigado por colocar o prefixo correto no título da {where}.",
            hasCard: ":thumbsup: {where} contém um card do Jira",
            doesntHaveCard: `{where} não contém um card do Jira no formato '<prefix>-<number>'. Exemplo: 'CA-123'`,
        },
...
                    context.message("prefixThanks", {}, {where: where})
...
```

issues.title: Fix files.matches not working when it's a directory match
issues.body:
`files.matches` no longer works when the pattern is `some_directory/**/*`, when the `basename` option is true. Patterns with `*.js` still work fine.

This seems to be an issue with the underlying micromatch/picomatch implementation: https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch/issues/89. My expectation is that when the pattern has a slash, `basename` should be ignored. No response to that issue though, so throwing a bandaid onto it to make our existing rules work again.

- Adds `DiffLine` (this does not extend `Line`)
- `FileState#lines({ before, after })` is now stricter on DiffLines
